titles.en: Inscription on the Hot Spring, Tang rubbing fragment

currentCollection.note: Described as held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France under the Pelliot number.
currentCollection.noteZh: 来源称该残卷藏于法国国家图书馆，编号 Pelliot chinois 4508。

review.note: Draft object record from a news report. The report confirms the holding but not the physical description.
review.noteZh: 依据新闻报道整理的草稿；报道确认收藏，但没有实物描述。

notes: The report calls this the earliest surviving rubbing in existence but gives no measurements or condition.
The original stone is lost; the record therefore makes no claim about the stone’s location.
The rubbing’s route from the Dunhuang library cave to Paris is not described in the cited report.
notesZh: 报道称其为存世最早的拓本，但没有尺寸与保存状况。
原石已佚，故本条不对原石所在作任何主张。
所引报道没有叙述此卷自敦煌藏经洞到巴黎的经过。
